method: Independent AI evaluation of every one of the 254 Spanish definition/example/Slovak hint combinations. Each row has an individually written semantic assessment. No authoring edits made by reviewer. This is AI linguistic judgment, not human or native-speaker approval, legal advice, or comprehensive dictionary verification. The selected sense and example constrain each hint; hints are not whole-sentence translations. CEFR placement is outside this Slovak review.

referenceEvidence.note: Targeted primary-source searches for Slovak rancidity wording, sports collocation and complicity yielded no adequate current headword evidence. No JULS dictionary verification is claimed. Historical search results were not used to certify modern usage.
